Your daily move.

Join, fund, roll

Join each season with the IMD buy-in. Deposit IMD separately for rent, tax and bail. Roll every 20 hours by default; the cooldown continues across seasons. Commit a secret, then reveal after the next EVM block. Keep the tab open and confirm both wallet requests.

A roll reserves your maximum possible landing charge, up to your balance. Excess remains withdrawable. Reveal within one hour and 200 blocks after the entropy block. Missing either deadline forfeits the reserve and puts you in jail and out of play for the season. Save your recovery secret.

Build your neighborhood

Land on a listed property to buy one deed, up to the season maximum. The IMD purchase swaps to the tile's token; set a minimum output from a fresh quote. Deeds cannot be transferred. Redeem for underlying tokens after 24 hours, or choose 30 days for 1.5× rent weight or 90 days for 2×. Boosted weight lasts until redemption.

80% of rent goes to holders by weight, and 20% to the pot. Without holders, all rent goes to the pot. If you cannot cover rent, you pay your balance and are bankrupt until next season. Deed and fund exits remain available.

Every square counts

Passing GO pays 10 bps of the available pot once per roll. Free Parking pays 50 bps once per UTC day per player. Tax and bail are 5 IMD. Chance and Community Chest send you to GO, jail, a 5 bps reward, tax, or nothing. In jail, pay bail or skip the next roll and wait another cooldown.

Vacant lots say “Launch Day soon.” Listed tiles can have one funded sponsor at a time, awarding tile tokens to landers through a separate claim. Anyone can replace an exhausted sponsor; earlier lander claims remain reserved. Unused sponsorship can be withdrawn after the season.

Season rewards

Score is salary, parking, Chance rewards, and current-season rent claimed before the end. Only positive scores qualify; joining alone earns no prize. Top ten shares of the 60% prize budget are 25/18/13/10/8/7/6/5/4/4%. At least 40% carries forward, plus unoccupied ranks and rounding. Ties use address order. Anyone can finalize an ended season. Prizes use individual claims.

Old rent and old prizes remain claimable but do not score in a new season. User funds cannot be withdrawn by the owner. The owner can list tiles or correct empty listings after all deeds and sponsorship funds are cleared, start seasons, change capped parameters between seasons, and pause new rolls or buys. Withdrawals, redemptions and claims work while paused.

The game uses future blockhash commit/reveal randomness. It is not a verifiable randomness oracle; chain operators can influence or censor blocks. Only reviewed standard tokens are supported. This is an address-based game with no Sybil resistance.
